## HO600 validation checklist

- [ ] No candidate was selected because of observed price movement.
- [ ] Candidate_Pool remains free of 2020/2026 price and change columns.
- [ ] Every proposed Exact admission has Exact-2020 + Exact-2026 normal/list/base evidence.
- [ ] Identity/spec/channel/geography comparability was checked.
- [ ] Promotions, coupons, BOGO, bundle-derived prices, and delivery markups were excluded.
- [ ] Duplicate economic concepts checked.
- [ ] Brand/source/product-family concentration checked.
- [ ] Workbook exported and re-imported successfully if canonical state changes.
- [ ] Formula-error scan passed.
- [ ] Exact/evidence/quota counts reconcile.
- [ ] `canonical/status.json` updated only if formal progress changes.
